title: From Xinjiang's desert to economic hubs: a power expressway that lights up both ends
authority_note: State wire service; primary source for the 42-line UHV network and Changji-Guquan ±1100 kV line.
claims: UHV defined as AC >= 1000 kV and DC >= +/-800 kV
Three UHV DC lines from Xinjiang account for over 90% of the region's outbound power
Nationwide network of 42 UHV lines bridges western energy deposits with central/eastern load centers
Since 2010 Xinjiang transmitted over 1 trillion kWh to 22 provincial regions; one-third from renewables
Changji-Guquan +/-1100 kV UHV DC line launched Sept 2019
Hami-Chongqing +/-800 kV line (June 2025); Hami South-Zhengzhou line (Jan 2014)
~20% of Anhui electricity and ~10% of Henan peak demand now from Xinjiang
draft_usage: Cited at draft.md:134 for the 42-project UHV network and Changji-Guquan (+/-1,100 kV) line.
issues: The draft's Source-127 parenthetical '22 AC + 20 DC, ~370 GW inter-regional capacity' and 'Changji-Guquan ~3,300 km / 12 GW' and 'Jiuquan-Xiangtan 2,383 km' are NOT present in the fetched Xinhua text; only the 42-line count and +/-1100 kV Changji-Guquan are corroborated here.
